title: The Parable of the Seats at the Table
description: Jesus tells a parable to the guests who chose the places of honor at the table. He advises them to take the lowest seat at a wedding, so that the host may invite them to move higher up, and they avoid being asked to give up their place in shame. He concludes with the principle that whoever exalts themselves will be humbled, and whoever humbles themselves will be exalted.
